product_boundary.source: maintainer clarification: plugins implement functions; resources and works are workshop content
product_boundary.resource: Source structures with provenance, exact hashes and reuse rights; workshop resource section.
product_boundary.plugin: Reusable authoring, simulation or scientific analysis capability; never a biological showcase as the product boundary.
product_boundary.work: Resource instances plus capability configuration, timeline, narrative and results; workshop works section.
product_boundary.existing_specialized_modules: Transitional content/capability coupling; preserve regression evidence while extracting reusable tools and work data.
product_boundary.priority: authoring foundation, then classic functional tools (including existing analysis), then new research plugins
product_boundary.implementation_status: planned; documentation correction does not implement runtime/schema/workshop split
